dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: #It seems your jokes have improved with practice, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Happy about that?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Absolutely. Finally, someone to share the load.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: ...Ah, you know what? Collei's helping out the Akademiya, but I haven't had the chance to check on her. Why don't you do me a favor, and... go do that.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Hold on, I thought you were having me over for dinner?

dialogues.speaker: Observe Layla
dialogues.text: (Layla seems to be getting some much-needed sleep.)

dialogues.speaker: Tamara
dialogues.text: Um... Miss...?

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Ooh, let's get some of this! It looks fresh!

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Alright, some of this to go, please.

dialogues.speaker: Shevirme
dialogues.text: You got it! Taking it home with you? For two, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: For tw— Oh! N—No, no, no, no, no. It's not... We don't...

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Just... one serving each! Separate! Not together!

dialogues.speaker: Shevirme
dialogues.text: Alright... Coming right up.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: *sigh* That was close...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Light on the sauce for mine, please.

dialogues.speaker: Shevirme
dialogues.text: No problem! Any preference for you, sir?

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Oh, extra on mine.

dialogues.speaker: Shevirme
dialogues.text: You got it!

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Have you decided on what to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Fine. I'll go ahead and order then.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: H—Hey! Wait a minute!

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: So, when you do the thing where you pretend not to hear a question if you don't want to answer, it works like a charm. But, not when I do it?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: That's because you have to use it on the right person.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Besides, you really think you can use my own tricks against me?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: You don't make it out to Gandharva Ville often, and there wasn't time for visiting earlier, so why don't you stay a few more days?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Sure! Got anything fun planned?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Not really... We usually just go camping, do a little fishing, have a barbecue, things like that.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: #Oh, and we invite {NICKNAME} along too, if {M#he's}{F#she's} in town.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Nice! I love camping! And a barbecue is a must!

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Don't get too excited. You might not know this, but Tighnari doesn't use seasoning when he grills.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Huh? No way...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Don't listen to him, Sethos. I prefer a clean taste, but you can put on as much as you like.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: *sigh* You could've at least played along...

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: ...You've changed, Cyno.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Hehe. Man, it's a shame Hat Guy hasn't been around lately, or I'd invite him to join — he's the perfect buffer for your nonsense.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I wouldn't mind him tagging along, either. It's just a shame he doesn't play cards.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: ...Do you want to know why?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Absolutely not.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Seriously, though, where did he go? Has anyone seen him around at all?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: I heard he's taking care of something in Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Oh, well I hope it all works out.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Well, this is an unexpected reunion.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Like three stars of different colors rising in the same sky — what a spectacular occasion!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Archon, and Miss Nilou from the Zubayr Theater! I—I'm... not interrupting anything, am I?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Of course not! I'm just relaxing, gazing up at the starry sky. I get a lot of inspiration for new dances when I come here.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Oh! I'm also here to get some inspiration. I thought I was the only one who did that...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Of course, the inspiration I need has to do with my studies...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Well, we might be searching for different things, but in the end, we're both just waiting for that spark to strike.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Hehe, but this time, it wasn't inspiration, but Lesser Lord Kusanali who came knocking instead.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: How do you know I'm not here searching for that same spark?

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: We must innovate, after all, even in dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Here, I brought some Candied Ajilenakh Nuts. May they bring us all sweet dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hey there! Ready to go full speed ahead with Cuilein An-bot and Bar-drone Bunny?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Our two Scouting Buddies are tuned up and ready for testing!

choices.text: Let's get started!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Nice! Sure takes you back to the gliding test days, huh?

choices.text: Hope you're not juggling too many things, Collei.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Don't worry. I'm using this station as a temporary office for the Fieldwise Center as a whole.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: But, it hasn't been too bad. Just a lot of data processing for our scout bots and some paperwork.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oh, and we also give suggestions on how to modify the internal mechanisms!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: When an investigation team comes along, we register them and check if emergency training is needed. Then, we take care of the departure procedures, allocate the required personnel and equipment...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: And then, we monitor the situation with their camp provisions and touch base with the logistics staff.

choices.text: That's a lot to handle!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I don't mind. It's just temporary. The center hasn't been open for too long, so we're still working out the kinks.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Yeah! Plus, verifying travel qualifications and keeping an eye on logistics is nothing new for me!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: And, the Akademiya is sending specialists to set up a formal administrative team soon. We just have to show them the ropes.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Some of them are here already. So, once that's set up, and the researchers submit their certifications, we can start delegating the work.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: And then we can take a well-deserved break!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Have you visited other places in Sumeru?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Haha, I asked Lisa and Kaeya for some recommendations before leaving, so I have a list!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Time's been a bit tight this trip, but Collei took me around Sumeru City, and we had tons of amazing food!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: She's one busy gal, though. So, I didn't wanna drag her from place to place. It made more sense to spend time here helping her out!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I'm sorry, Amber...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: For what, haha? I'm having a blast!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Seeing you take the reins, seeing your friends place their trust in you... even rely on you... It makes me so happy!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Traveling, relaxing... I can do that whenever. It's not like this is my last time here!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Besides, once we're done, there will still be more than enough time for sight-seeing!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Th—That makes me even more determined!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: ...You don't need to worry about me, Amber! I've got this!

choices.text: They should pay you more.
I think I'll come back later.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: No rush! Whenever you're ready!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Yep, we'll be here!

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back. Ready to delve into the art of solving mechanical puzzles? Or, did you want to have a chat?

choices.text: Let's crack these puzzles!

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: I like the enthusiasm. I can see a thirst for knowledge shining in your eyes, so let's see what you've got!

choices.text: I wanted to ask a few questions, actually.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Hmph, as you wish. When it's you doing the asking, I'm an open book.

choices.text: Would you prefer a doll that is cute or refined?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Refined, naturally...

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Not that I have anything against "cuteness." A plush little thing with big eyes and a round face... I can see the appeal as much as anyone.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: But at my age, clinging to such objects like a child is somewhat... undignified.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Now, some of the newer stuff on the market is just exquisite... made with the finest material, sculpted in elegant lines, with features that glitter like gemstones...

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: The element of cuteness is there. But, it also doubles as a piece of art...

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Wait a second... I thought your questions were going to be academic in nature. What is the meaning of this?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Just... wanted to learn more about you!

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Ahem! Fine. I'll let it go this once. But, that excuse won't work a second time!

choices.text: Which is better... Autonomous or manually-operated devices?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Ah, a classic debate.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: I don't think this is a question that has a definitive answer... not for me, at least. It depends entirely on the scenario.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Simply put, if the task requires repetitive mechanical work that dilutes the value of human mental labor, then automated devices are superior.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: But where "identification," "analysis," and "decision-making" are critical, manual control is always safer.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Human thought is complex. Even if we were to simulate a six-year-old's mind, the demands in terms of component design, system weight, and energy cost would be immense.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: As I see it, conventional hardware capable of simulating adult-level cognition is impossible to integrate into a compact device — for the foreseeable future, anyway.

choices.text: That was a very concise summary.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Well, I've told you before, if you find these topics interesting, you should come to my classes.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Cyrus's student, Lisa Minci, is known as a "once in a generation" genius. But, with your smarts, I bet you could give her a run for her Mora!

choices.text: I feel smarter already...
I've got a few other things to wrap up...

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Of course! Don't let me keep you. Come back whenever you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Hey! Ready to do some quality assurance on our test questions?

choices.text: More than ready!

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Wonderful. Just don't forget to pace yourself.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Yep. All you gotta do is defeat a certain number within the time limit. But, hey... leave some for the trainees, okay?

choices.text: I'm not in a rush. Up for a chat?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Sure! Feels like it's been ages since we last saw each other.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: If we'd known you were coming, we would've prepared a whole welcome feast! All new recipes and everything!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: All new?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: It's a funny story, actually. The last time I was in Fontaine, I brought a few cook books and some spices back with me.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Then, I gave them to Candace, and she went into full chef mode, coming up with all sorts of new things...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Like... "Romaritime Flower Meat Jerky Mixed Rice." At first glance, it looks no different than the usual Aaru Mixed Rice...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: But then it hits your tongue, and... You get that delicious meat, the hearty rice, and this super refreshing aftertaste. All without being greasy!

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: It's a great way to refuel, and it's not too dry. Honestly, perfect for camping out in the desert.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: I'm not against improving traditional cuisine... within the bounds of reason, of course.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: After all, every ingredient is precious out in the desert. Nothing must go to waste.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Why didn't you accept that outfit from me, then? Fabrics are a valuable resource too.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: I mean, I know I'm pretty casual, and not the most "fashionable," I guess... But I had someone help me pick it out. I'm sure nothing was wrong with the fit.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: In the end, it went to the girl in our merc band who does the accounting. She seemed to appreciate it, at least.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: I did appreciate it, Dehya. It was extremely thoughtful.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: But as the Guardian of Aaru Village, my goal is to blend in, not stand out. Besides, fine clothes should go to people who have an occasion to wear them.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: If your accountant is to represent the Blazing Beasts in business settings, she should have something to wear. That's why I recommended the clothes go to her.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Oh! Why didn't you say so earlier? I thought you just didn't like what I picked out!

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Well, seeing as the Blazing Beasts will be holing up in Aaru Village for the foreseeable future, if you still want to offer something as thanks...

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: You could bring us some bolts of cloth. I'm somewhat familiar with tailoring, and I could use them to fashion sand and dust-resistant cloaks for everyone.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: The fabric doesn't need to be expensive, just resistant to wear and tear. I trust your judgment on that.

choices.text: You're a real pragmatist, Candace...

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Don't worry. I'll think carefully about the shape and pattern when I make one for you.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Then all will know that you are an esteemed guest of our village.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ooh, so I'm getting one too!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thanks! No need to make it too complicated!

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Oh man, I'm getting kind of excited, ha...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: In that case, maybe I'll head to Liyue next. I've heard you can get some really nice fabric there without breaking the bank...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Oh, and they've got a huge selection of silks as well, if that's what we're going for.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: But, they've also got security in spades, so no merc work for us. We'll just be tourists — polite, well-behaved travelers.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Once we're done here, I'll make a plan with the rest of the Beasts.

choices.text: A cloak is perfect for this environment...
Give me a bit, I'll be right back.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: No worries! We'll start once you're in peak form!

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Feel free to get some rest if you need it. We have more than enough time.

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: #Haha... Hahaha... {NICKNAME}, my benefactor, we meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: I'm Hajanad, a new scholar at the Spantamad. It's my job to lead our specialists inside to assist with the upcoming operations of the Fieldwise Center.

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: However, before that, there's a brief handover process to complete. Please give me a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: Hello, my dear benefactor. I'll be overseeing the Scouting Buddies program going forward and carefully documenting all relevant information.

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: Is there anything I can help you with?

choices.text: I'd like to give the Scouting Buddies another go...

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: No problem! This time, I'll use an even more precise model to analyze your data!

choices.text: Are you a student with the Spantamad?

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: That's right. My Darshan doesn't get directly involved in mechanical research.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: But that's not an issue. Thanks to your earlier efforts, all the key rules and operating guidelines are already in place — managing booths and keeping things running is something scholars from any Darshan can handle.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: In areas where specialized manpower isn't required, cutting costs happens to align perfectly with our latest principles.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Among the scholars on standby nearby, there are quite a few outstanding members from the Kshahrewar who can be called in at any time should the Scouting Buddies require calibration.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Having said that, looking at how things are going right now, the Scouting Buddies seem to be doing very well. So there's nothing to worry about!

choices.text: Keep up the good work!

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Thank you. I'll be sure to come thank you in person if and when I get some impressive results!

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: The gifts, the wages, and Miss Dehya's introduction letter, everything's ready to go...

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: I wonder if Miss Nilou is busy... And if she'll be shocked to hear she's going so far away...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wanna play cards?

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Huh, esteemed traveler!? I can't believe you tracked me all the way here...

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Well... alright, let's play. Though I might not be able to focus...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: With this experience under my belt, my next trip out here should be a piece of cake!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Of course, this one isn't over yet, but you've been going non-stop these past few days. Maybe we should head back to your place and take it easy for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Sounds good to me!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I have a bunch of ingredients, snacks, and knick-knacks back home that I've been wanting to show you!

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: I had a wonderful time. Yes, a wonderful time indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Now, to write a list of texts to send back with that enthusiastic young girl.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Candace. I won't drink too much. Trust me.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: I'm not worried about that. I just think drinking some nutritious tea could help counteract some of the negative effects on the body, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Well, lucky for me I know how to drink in moderation, then!

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Oh, and I've got quite a bit of that tea still, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: So, uh... thanks for that, but no need to send me more right now. Oh, and thank the kids for me as well!
